title: Lecture 12 — Vectors
summary: Describe displacement in two and three dimensions, combine vectors, and find lengths and unit directions.
body:
Based on the planned Algebra 1.1 coverage, work from points to displacements, then component arithmetic, scalar multiples, lengths and unit vectors. The two examples and two self-checks cover both two and three dimensions. Dot products and orthogonality follow in the next planned lecture.

Exercise 12 uses Algebra section 1.1, page 13, exercises 3, 5, 10, 11, 13, 16, 17, 20, D1, D5, P1 and P2. This vector practice belongs to the second half of the exercise session. Mini-exam 2 covers Lectures 5–10; vectors are part of the later material.
